_freeze_source: docs/decisions/pilot_freeze_2026-08-18.md - decisions P-003 through P-007, recorded in DECISIONS.md under 'Proposed decisions awaiting ratification'.
_freeze_provenance: Frozen 2026-08-18 at the project owner's direction, after confirming origin/main carried no recorded decision for U-001 through U-006 and that DECISIONS.md assigns those items no owner. NOT a team freeze: every value traces to written evidence and a stated reversal condition, and any owner may override. Frozen for execution, provisional for authorship.
_warning: Executable. Every value below is fixed before any primary chain runs. Changing one after a chain has run invalidates budget matching; add a new config instead.
_condition: primary pilot: the frozen horizon, budget, total-token match, ordered seeds, outcomes, contrast, and exclusions shared by the no_rescue, random, schedule_only, selection_only, and joint arms.
_arms: Five conditions. PROTOCOL.md section 4 names six treatment families; the sixth, an oracle upper bound, is not implemented and is deliberately absent rather than approximated. Its absence bounds what the comparison can claim.

no_rescue.note: No config file. NoRescuePolicy takes no parameters by design: it ignores budget and candidates so the control arm cannot begin spending if a budget field changes.

_budget_units: Optimizer tokens under the frozen GPT-2 tokenizer, per DECISIONS.md P-002 and FAILURE_LOG.md F-010b. NOT whitespace word counts. Derivation in docs/decisions/pilot_freeze_2026-08-18.md, U-003.

data._subsample_note: First 400 articles in frozen manifest order. Deterministic because the manifest is. Rationale and cost derivation: docs/decisions/pilot_freeze_2026-08-18.md, U-002.
data._train_manifest_sha256_note: Bytes of the manifest file as of 2026-08-18, after optimizer_token_count was added. Its manifest_hash (content identity over example_id and content_hash) is unchanged at 77d2793a28cc1cd5, so partition identity and disjointness are unaffected.

primary_contrast: joint minus the strongest eligible non-joint baseline, where eligibility is fixed by PREREGISTRATION.md and may not be chosen using primary treatment outcomes
_exclusion_rules: Verbatim from PREREGISTRATION.md 'Exclusions'. Divergence, harmful performance, null performance and negligible effects are scientific outcomes, not exclusions.
exclusion_rules: a corrupt or missing required artifact
a verified wrong frozen config or code commit
verified data leakage or manifest mismatch
infrastructure termination before a required checkpoint
_minimum_chains_note: Five paired chains per arm, the frozen primary seed set. Uncertainty is computed across chains; generations within a chain are repeated observations. This is a pilot sized to estimate variance, not a powered test - COMPUTE.md's compute gate blocks the powered experiment until pilot variance is known.
